summary: Mono-red Goblin tokens for Arena Historic Brawl (1v1, 25 life). Land [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] on turn 4 with haste already on the table and tap him at once: "Create X 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens, where X is the number of Goblins you control", so the Goblin count doubles every turn. Every token that enters is damage through [[Purphoros, God of the Forge]] (2), [[Impact Tremors]] (1), [[General Kreat, the Boltbringer]] (1) and [[Witty Roastmaster]] (1). Sacrifice outlets ([[Skirk Prospector]], [[Ashnod's Altar]], [[Goblin Bombardment]]) turn the swarm into mana and damage, and with [[Aggravated Assault]] into unbounded combats. The base list is the model's own version (2026-10-08 collection-wide search); its 11 role-window filler swaps are reverted and 17 colourless or off-colour lands became Mountains.

phases.goal: A one-drop Goblin or a rock, then a haste source: [[Goblin Warchief]] ("Goblins you control have haste") or [[Lightning Greaves]] waiting with equip {0}. [[Goblin Matron]] fetches Warchief.
Krenko with haste, tap every main phase before combat. Add the enter-damage payoffs and attack with the hasty tokens.
One more Krenko tap through Purphoros and Tremors, an Assault loop, or the Sharpshooter machine gun. Hold a redirect for the removal aimed at Krenko.

engine.title: Krenko doubles every turn
flow: [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] turn 4, taps at once
engine.note: Krenko is a Goblin, so Warchief's haste covers him. Tap before combat every main phase; the tokens attack with haste under Warchief, [[Howlsquad Heavy]] or [[Fervor]].

engine.title: Prospector + Assault loop
flow: [[Krenko, Mob Boss]] taps for X Goblins
[[Aggravated Assault]]: untap all creatures, extra combat and main phase
Krenko taps again with a bigger army
engine.note: Needs 6 Goblins including Krenko: tap for 6, sacrifice 5, net +1 and an extra combat each loop. Howlsquad Heavy at max speed ("{T}: Add {R} for each Goblin you control") pays for Assault without sacrificing.

engine.title: Sharpshooter machine gun
flow: sacrifice a Goblin to [[Goblin Bombardment]]: 1 damage
[[Goblin Sharpshooter]] untaps ("Whenever a creature dies, untap this creature")
engine.note: [[Collective Inferno]] on Goblin doubles Sharpshooter's damage. Bombardment is not a Goblin, so Inferno does not double it.

engine.title: Protecting the one card that matters
flow: [[Cavern of Souls]] on Goblin: Krenko can't be countered
[[Redirect Lightning]] / [[Return the Favor]] move the removal onto a token
engine.note: Greaves shroud also stops your own [[Expedite]], [[Torch Courier]] and [[Goblin Motivator]] from targeting Krenko: Greaves on Krenko, Boots on Warchief.

winConditions.name: Krenko doubling with enter damage
winConditions.damage: 6 tokens × (2 + 1) = 18 on the tap; the next tap makes 12 tokens = 36. From 25 life two taps kill without attacking.
winConditions.turn: T6 (Krenko T4, goldfish commander turn 4.6; model-lab score of the list)

winConditions.name: Unbounded combats
flow: attack with hasty Goblins, Krenko taps again
winConditions.damage: Each loop attacks with the whole untapped army and ends with more Goblins than it started: lethal in 3–4 loops from 6 Goblins.
winConditions.turn: T6–7 (Assault {2}{R} plus the first activation {3}{R}{R} = 8 mana over two turns, or Prospector mana)

winConditions.name: Machine gun
winConditions.damage: 2 per Goblin; [[Goblin Grenade]] adds 5 for one Goblin; [[Collective Inferno]] doubles the Sharpshooter half.
winConditions.turn: Any turn after a Krenko tap; works at instant speed in response to a wipe

winConditions.name: Storm
flow: [[Empty the Warrens]] copies: 2 Goblins per spell
winConditions.damage: Storm 5: Warrens makes 12 Goblins (24 with Purphoros), Grapeshot 6, Guttersnipe 12.
winConditions.turn: Backup when Krenko is exiled; needs 4+ cheap spells in hand

metrics.note: Model-lab /api/score, source arena, format brawl, 300 seeded games. The objective drops because the role windows reward the filler cards that were cut (draw 7 vs window 10–12).

keepers.why: Costs {R} on a full board. Sacrifice your Goblins to [[Skirk Prospector]] or [[Goblin Bombardment]] in response and it is a one-sided reset.
The only counterspell in red. Use it on their wipe or on the counter aimed at Krenko; the random free spell is the price.
Five mana, but with 8 Goblins it enters with 8 fellowship counters: every token is a 9/9.
Doubles Kreat, Instigator, Matron, Volley Veteran and Searslicer triggers. It does not double Krenko (activated ability).
Refills after a wipe; the protection turn covers recasting Krenko.
Convoke with tokens, then every Goblin's combat damage and Sharpshooter ping is doubled.
With 21 Mountains it is live from turn 6: 3 damage per land drop.
Haste for the tokens, a free attacker every combat, and at max speed the mana for Assault without sacrificing.

nearTies.note: Flail's "opponents can't cast spells during your turn" protects the combo turn; Heist adds the combat. Operator's call.
Gamble is a tutor with a random discard; Glassworks is clean removal. Keep Gamble while the hand is usually tokens-to-be.

pilotRules: Never cast Krenko without haste on the table or Greaves/Boots ready, unless the opponent is tapped out.
Tap Krenko every main phase before combat; the enter-damage triggers do not need haste.
Greaves on Krenko, Boots on Warchief: Greaves shroud blocks your own Expedite, Courier and Motivator.
Removal on Krenko: Redirect Lightning, Untimely Malfunction or Return the Favor onto a token; if it resolves, sacrifice to Prospector for mana first.
Wipe coming: keep half the fodder in hand, sacrifice the board to Bombardment or Altar in response.
Tap Krenko first, then activate Aggravated Assault: the untap is the point.
Choose Goblin on Cavern of Souls, Unclaimed Territory, Roaming Throne, Collective Inferno, Banner of Kinship and Dawn-Blessed Pennant.
Lethal maths: Purphoros 2 + Tremors 1 + Kreat 1 + Roastmaster 1 = 5 per token at full engine; divide their life by that before deciding whether to attack at all.
